description: Shopee is an e-commerce marketplace platform for merchants and sellers. Its Open Platform lets developers build apps that manage shop operations such as products, orders, logistics, marketing, and related seller workflows.
summary: Shopee exposes a documented Open Platform HTTP API across several regional base domains plus an OAuth-protected MCP server at `https://mcp.shopee.com/openai/v1`; no Shopee CLI or GraphQL surface was found.
